keys.app.title: KERNEL PANIC
keys.story.macos.mac_classic_intro: A clean desktop promises simplicity. The process table has other plans.
keys.story.macos.mac_classic_klog:
finder: one window opened
menu bar: pretending to be calm
process table: welcome, small daemon
keys.story.macos.mac_aqua_intro: Everything is translucent, smooth and hiding a route. Read the telegraph, not the polish.
keys.story.macos.mac_aqua_klog:
aqua: fluid surface enabled
compositor: depth is not safety
race condition: two windows share a bad idea
keys.story.macos.mac_darwin_intro: The shell opens onto its lower layer. Background services are still services, even when they look expensive.
keys.story.macos.mac_darwin_klog:
darwin: substrate visible
launchd: background work detected
memory: the polished shell is still consuming it
keys.story.macos.mac_modern_intro: The system asks for permission to do everything, then forgets who granted it. Clear the route and keep your process alive.
keys.story.macos.mac_modern_klog:
security: consent dialog misplaced
service: running in the background
root: permission denied // retrying
